scripts.start: AGENTS=2 BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) npm run network
scripts.dev: VITE_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) VITE_APP_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) UI_PORT=8888 npm run x
scripts.x: hc s clean &&  npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run start:happ" "hc kitsune2-bootstrap-srv --listen 127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT"
scripts.start:moss-x: concurrently "npm start -w ui" "sleep 1 && weave --agent-idx 1 --dev-config we_dev/config.ts" "sleep 10 && weave --agent-idx 2 --dev-config we_dev/config.ts"
scripts.network: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=8888 concurrently "npm start -w ui" "npm run launch:happ"
scripts.test: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive && npm t -w tests
scripts.package: rm -rf ui/dist && rm -f ui/dist.zip && npm run build:happ && npm run package -w ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive && npm run weave-hash
scripts.start:happ: echo "starting with admin $VITE_ADMIN_PORT" && RUST_LOG=warn echo "pass" | hc s -f=$VITE_ADMIN_PORT --piped generate workdir/ziptest.happ --run=$VITE_APP_PORT -a ziptest network -b "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT"  quic "http://127.0.0.1:$BOOTSTRAP_PORT"
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
